references.source:
def payload_slice_hits(segments, offset, span):
    if offset < 0 or span < 0:
        raise ValueError("invalid slice")
    logical_pos = 0
    target_hi = offset + span
    counts = []
    for entry in segments:
        kind, length = entry[0], entry[1]
        if length < 0 or (kind != "data" and kind != "meta"):
            raise ValueError("invalid segment")
        if kind == "meta":
            continue
        next_pos = logical_pos + length
        overlap = min(target_hi, next_pos) - max(offset, logical_pos)
        counts.append(overlap if overlap > 0 else 0)
        logical_pos = next_pos
    return counts
